sql: -- First, let's see what teams and memberships exist
SELECT t.id as team_id, t.name as team_name, m.userId as user_id, m.role, u.email
LEFT JOIN "Membership" m ON t.id = m."teamId"
LEFT JOIN "User" u ON m."userId" = u.id
